one_month_reasoning: No Snowflake earnings in the window (Q3 FY27 report is scheduled for 2026-12-02). The main scheduled event is the Oct 27-28 FOMC, where Polymarket/Kalshi price a ~65-69% chance of a 25bp hike (Sep 26-29 readings) with the 10-year near 5.17%; that is largely priced, but a long-duration 16x-forward-sales stock is exposed to any hawkish surprise. Short-horizon regularities are mixed: post-earnings drift after the +21% Sep 3 gap argues mildly up, while the literature on past-winner reversals and the 5% short interest ($6.2B) argue for chop. Net: essentially symmetric lognormal centred at ~$336 (a hair below spot for the rate risk) with ~16% monthly sigma (slightly under the 62%/3.5 = 17.7% rule because realized vol was inflated by the April AI-disintermediation crash and the September earnings gap).

fair_value.method: Blend of EV/NTM revenue (12.5x on ~$9.6B NTM revenue as of Sep-2027 plus ~$3B net cash, / 385M shares = $320) and forward P/E (FY29E non-GAAP EPS ~$4.20 x 75x = $315), weighted 60/40; multiple compresses from ~16x today as growth decelerates toward mid-20s, consistent with the growth-to-multiple line across peers (PLTR 45x at 63% growth, DDOG 10.6x at 20%, MDB 6.2x at 17.5%).

bear.story: Growth decelerates back to ~20% as AI consumption tailwind normalises, or AI-disintermediation fears return (as in the Apr-2026 56% drawdown); rates rise further (Fed hikes Oct/Dec) and the multiple resets to ~8x NTM sales, near the early-2026 trough. SNOW has done this twice: -70% after the Nov-2021 peak and -56% into Apr-2026.

base.story: Product growth holds low-to-mid 30s near term, fading to mid-20s by FY29; revenue compounds ~28% but multiple compresses from ~16x to ~12.5x, so price roughly flat; fair value ~$320-340.

bull.story: Fourth/fifth consecutive quarter of acceleration, AI products (CoCo/CoWork, Cortex) become a visible revenue line, FY28 guide at 30%+; multiple holds ~15-16x on ~$10B NTM revenue; consistent with the upper half of the $414 mean / $525 high analyst targets.

thesis_break_reason: Below ~$215 (about -36%, back under the pre-Q2-earnings breakout zone and roughly 11x current-year sales) the market would be telling us the reacceleration was a one-off: product growth sliding back toward 20%, NRR falling from 126%, or AI agents displacing warehouse spend. That is more than ordinary 1-sigma volatility over a few months and would coincide with a fundamental guide-down.

reasoning: Anchor: SNOW's own history shows extreme two-way base rates: a 70% drawdown after the Nov-2021 $402 peak, a 56% peak-to-trough fall into April 2026, and then a round-trip to new highs with a +21% one-day gap on Q2 FY27 (third straight quarter of acceleration, product +37%, FY guide raised to $6.07B/+36%, op margin 14.5%). Realized vol of 62% is inflated by those two shocks; I use ~40-50% effective forward vol via a three-component mixture. Valuation base rate: LTM EV/rev has compressed each year (32.9x 2024, 25x 2025, ~20x now; ~16x forward, top of 3-year range, 132x NTM P/E). The cross-section (PLTR 45x at 63% growth, DDOG 10.6x at 20%, MDB 6.2x at 17.5%) implies ~12-13x for the mid-20s growth SNOW will likely show by late 2027, so revenue growth of ~28% is mostly eaten by multiple compression: fair value ~$320, about spot. Analyst mean target $414 (34/40 buys) is a bullish tilt, but sell-side targets after large rallies historically overshoot. Event base rates: post-earnings drift after large positive surprises supports modest continuation for ~3 months, but academic work finds ~50% of earnings-day 'gap' reactions reverse over time and past winners reverse around announcements. Macro: prediction markets flipped hawkish (Polymarket ~67% Oct hike, ~72% Dec hike, ~3% any 2026 cut; Kalshi 2026 recession ~6%), a headwind for long-duration names. Combined: median ~$337 (flat), mean ~$350, fat left tail (22% bear at ~$190) and right tail (25% bull at ~$480). Research was limited to ~14 queries; Kalshi page returned 429 so its figures come via secondary reporting.
